title: Quick Chinese-Style Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful dish made with asparagus, quick-cooked in a Chinese-inspired stir fry sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic; stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the asparagus; stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until tender but still crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, hoisin sauce (if using), salt, and pepper.
Pour the sauce over the asparagus and stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the asparagus is well coated.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
